preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string can be empty.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only characters that are present in the input string.
Each character in the output string must appear more than once in the input string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == sum(1 for c in s if s.count(c) > 1)
postconditions.description: The length of the output string must equal the count of characters in the input string that appear more than once.
